description: mta_sts_error.rs: DnsLookupFailed(String), PolicyFetchFailed(String), PolicyParseFailed(String) wrap raw error messages as strings. Callers who want to match on the inner cause (e.g. to distinguish a timeout from a cert error in PolicyFetchFailed) cannot do so without string parsing. Idiomatic Rust: structured variants like PolicyFetchFailed { kind: FetchErrorKind, source: reqwest::Error } let callers inspect the cause without string parsing. At minimum the variants that wrap dynamic errors should hold a Box<dyn Error> or a thiserror source. Current approach loses structured information on the error path.
title: MtaStsError string variants wrap String instead of structured fields
